[[File:Shadow of the Mad King banner.jpg|500px|right]] {{Quotation|game|Shadow of the Mad King, our annual Halloween festival, returns with ghoulish capers, spooky fights, and holiday fun! Gather together with the citizens of Lion’s Arch to enjoy another year of tricks, treats, and terrible jokes.}} [[Halloween]] is a [[festival]] celebrated annually in October and November in the world of [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. Lasting three weeks, this celebration brings many seasonal events and activities in [[Lion's Arch]] and [[starting area]]s. This period is also denoted by the weakening of the barriers separating Tyria from [[the Underworld]], resulting in many paranormal phenomena, and the arrival of the [[Mad King Thorn]], his [[Lunatic Court]], candy elementals, as well as a myriad of ghosts and other creatures. == Releases == * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2012]] (2012-10-22 — 2012-11-01) * [[Blood and Madness 2013]] (2013-10-15 — 2013-11-11) * [[Blood and Madness 2014]] (2014-10-21 — 2014-11-04) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2015]] (2015-10-23 — 2015-11-06) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2016]] (2016-10-18 — 2016-11-08) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2017]] (2017-10-17 — 2017-11-07) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2018]] (2018-10-16 — 2018-11-06) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2019]] (2019-10-15 — 2019-11-05) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2020]] (2020-10-13 — 2020-11-03) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2021]] (2021-10-05 — 2021-11-09) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2022]] (2022-10-18 — 2022-11-08) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2023]] (2023-10-17 — 2023-11-07) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2024]] (2024-10-15 — 2024-11-05) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2025]] (2025-10-07 — 2025-11-04) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2026]] (2026-10-13 — 2026-11-03) == Story == {{see|Halloween/story|label=For story related to Halloween}} Since its original release, Shadow of the Mad King contains story related to the [[Mad King Thorn]], his allies and foes, which is told via [[event]]s, [[collection]]s, and historically via [[story]] instances. == Activities == === Zones === {| {{STDT|location sortable}} style="max-width:134em;" |- ! class="unsortable" | Loading screen !!
